answer: Require every agent identity to lock a real stake in escrow before it can earn, like a jetty that only admits boats carrying cargo. To forge a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand separate deposits, and any identity caught double-voting or copying work forfeits its stake. Bind each stake to one unique hardware attestation, so no two identities share a root key — the juniper rule. Attack cost grows with each fake agent, while an honest agent pays once and keeps earning.
